queries.title: Search terms
queries.description: One Pinterest search per line, e.g. "christmas nails classy".

maxPinsPerQuery.title: Max pins per search
maxPinsPerQuery.description: How many pins to collect for each search term.

saveImages.title: Save images
saveImages.description: Stores each pin's full-size image in the key-value store as PIN_<id>.p0, .p1 ... (190 KB chunks; join them in order).

saveVideos.title: Save videos
saveVideos.description: Stores each video pin's MP4 as PINV_<id>.p0, .p1 ... (190 KB chunks).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Pinterest blocks many datacenter IPs; Residential works best.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a blocked search with a new IP.

debugProbe.title: Probe responses (debug)
debugProbe.description: Saves a short report of what Pinterest returned (PROBE record) for the first search, instead of scraping.
